name: Insider
summary: A social deduction word-guessing game where one hidden insider knows the secret word and steers yes/no questions without being caught.
rules_text: Setup a deck of theme word cards and role tiles: one judge, one insider, rest commons. Deal one role tile hidden to each player except judge who reveals. Judge secretly looks at top theme card and shows the word only to the insider with eyes closed, so only judge and insider know it. Phase 1 Guessing: players have a timed period to ask judge only yes/no/I-don't-know questions to deduce the word. Anyone may ask, insider must blend in while subtly guiding toward answer. If someone guesses the exact word, note who guessed; if time expires, all lose. Phase 2 Discussion: timed open discussion about who the insider is, based on question patterns. Phase 3 Judgment: vote whether guesser is insider. Then if needed all simultaneously point to suspect; most votes is accused. If accused is insider, judge and commons win; otherwise insider wins. Roles rotate each round.
rating_reason: Hidden insider word game, bluffing and discussion.
